import { markdownToHtml, sanitizeHtml } from './markdown.js';
import { clearNote, loadNote, saveNote } from './storage.js';

const editor = document.getElementById('editor');
const preview = document.getElementById('preview');
const saveBtn = document.getElementById('saveBtn');
const clearBtn = document.getElementById('clearBtn');
const saveStatus = document.getElementById('saveStatus');

const showFatalError = (message) => {
  const container = document.querySelector('main') ?? document.body;
  const el = document.createElement('p');
  el.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
  el.style.padding = '1rem';
  el.textContent = message;
  container.prepend(el);
};

if (!(editor instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement) || !(preview instanceof HTMLElement)) {
  showFatalError('App failed to load: missing editor or preview.');
} else {
  const renderPreview = () => {
    const raw = markdownToHtml(editor.value);
    preview.innerHTML = sanitizeHtml(raw);
  };

  let autosaveTimer = null;
  const scheduleAutosave = () => {
    if (autosaveTimer) window.clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
    autosaveTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
      saveNote(window.localStorage, editor.value);
    }, 300);
  };

  const doSave = () => {
    saveNote(window.localStorage, editor.value);
    if (saveStatus) saveStatus.textContent = 'Saved';
  };

  const doClear = () => {
    editor.value = '';
    clearNote(window.localStorage);
    renderPreview();
    if (saveStatus) saveStatus.textContent = 'Cleared';
  };

  editor.addEventListener('input', () => {
    renderPreview();
    scheduleAutosave();
  });

  saveBtn?.addEventListener('click', doSave);
  clearBtn?.addEventListener('click', doClear);

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    const isMac = navigator.platform.toLowerCase().includes('mac');
    const mod = isMac ? e.metaKey : e.ctrlKey;
    if (!mod) return;

    const key = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (key === 's') {
      e.preventDefault();
      doSave();
    } else if (key === 'l') {
      e.preventDefault();
      doClear();
    }
  });

  // Restore on load
  editor.value = loadNote(window.localStorage);
  renderPreview();
}

const escapeHtml = (s) =>
  s
    .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
    .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
    .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
    .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
    .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');

const inlineMarkdownToHtml = (text) => {
  // Escape first, then re-introduce safe HTML for markdown constructs.
  let html = escapeHtml(text);

  // Code spans
  html = html.replaceAll(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');

  // Links: [text](https://...)
  html = html.replaceAll(
    /\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^\s)]+)\)/g,
    '<a href="$2" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">$1</a>'
  );

  // Bold + italics
  html = html.replaceAll(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  html = html.replaceAll(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');

  return html;
};

const serializeAttributes = (el, allowedForTag) => {
  const parts = [];
  for (const attr of Array.from(el.attributes ?? [])) {
    if (!allowedForTag?.has(attr.name)) continue;
    const value = String(attr.value ?? '');
    const escaped = value
      .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
      .replaceAll('"', '&quot;');
    parts.push(`${attr.name}="${escaped}"`);
  }
  return parts.length ? ' ' + parts.join(' ') : '';
};

const serializeNode = (node, allowedAttrs) => {
  const pieces = [];
  for (const child of Array.from(node.children ?? [])) {
    const attrs = serializeAttributes(child, allowedAttrs[child.tagName]);
    const inner = child.children?.length
      ? serializeNode(child, allowedAttrs)
      : escapeHtml(child.textContent ?? '');
    pieces.push(`<${child.tagName.toLowerCase()}${attrs}>${inner}</${child.tagName.toLowerCase()}>`);
  }
  return pieces.join('');
};

/**
 * A tiny markdown-to-HTML renderer for the preview.
 * Supported: headings (#, ##, ###), paragraphs, blockquotes, unordered lists,
 * fenced code blocks, inline code, bold/italics, and http(s) links.
 *
 * Output is safe-by-construction (escapes user content), but still run through
 * `sanitizeHtml` as a defense-in-depth step.
 */
export const markdownToHtml = (markdown) => {
  const input = (markdown ?? '').replaceAll('\r\n', '\n');
  const lines = input.split('\n');

  const out = [];
  let inCode = false;
  let codeLines = [];
  let inList = false;

  const closeList = () => {
    if (inList) {
      out.push('</ul>');
      inList = false;
    }
  };

  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trimEnd();

    if (trimmed.startsWith('```')) {
      if (inCode) {
        out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n'))}</code></pre>`);
        inCode = false;
        codeLines = [];
      } else {
        closeList();
        inCode = true;
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (inCode) {
      codeLines.push(line);
      continue;
    }

    if (trimmed === '') {
      closeList();
      continue;
    }

    const h3 = trimmed.match(/^###\s+(.+)$/);
    if (h3) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<h3>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(h3[1])}</h3>`);
      continue;
    }

    const h2 = trimmed.match(/^##\s+(.+)$/);
    if (h2) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<h2>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(h2[1])}</h2>`);
      continue;
    }

    const h1 = trimmed.match(/^#\s+(.+)$/);
    if (h1) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<h1>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(h1[1])}</h1>`);
      continue;
    }

    const bq = trimmed.match(/^>\s?(.+)$/);
    if (bq) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<blockquote><p>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(bq[1])}</p></blockquote>`);
      continue;
    }

    const li = trimmed.match(/^-\s+(.+)$/);
    if (li) {
      if (!inList) {
        out.push('<ul>');
        inList = true;
      }
      out.push(`<li>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(li[1])}</li>`);
      continue;
    }

    closeList();
    out.push(`<p>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(trimmed)}</p>`);
  }

  closeList();
  if (inCode) {
    out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n'))}</code></pre>`);
  }

  return out.join('\n');
};

/**
 * Sanitizes HTML by parsing it and removing dangerous elements/attributes.
 * Keep an allowlist small: the preview only needs basic formatting.
 */
export const sanitizeHtml = (html) => {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(html ?? '', 'text/html');

  const allowedTags = new Set([
    'A',
    'P',
    'H1',
    'H2',
    'H3',
    'EM',
    'STRONG',
    'CODE',
    'PRE',
    'UL',
    'OL',
    'LI',
    'BLOCKQUOTE',
    'BR',
  ]);

  const allowedAttrs = {
    A: new Set(['href', 'rel', 'target']),
  };

  const walk = (node) => {
    const children = Array.from(node.children ?? []);
    for (const el of children) {
      if (!allowedTags.has(el.tagName)) {
        const text = doc.createTextNode(el.textContent ?? '');
        el.replaceWith(text);
        continue;
      }

      for (const attr of Array.from(el.attributes ?? [])) {
        const allowedForTag = allowedAttrs[el.tagName];
        const isAllowed = allowedForTag?.has(attr.name);
        if (!isAllowed) el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
      }

      if (el.tagName === 'A') {
        const href = el.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(href)) el.removeAttribute('href');
        el.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
        el.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
      }

      walk(el);
    }
  };

  walk(doc.body);

  // Use a deterministic serializer (so unit tests can stub DOMParser in Node).
  if (typeof doc.body.innerHTML === 'string') return doc.body.innerHTML;
  return serializeNode(doc.body, allowedAttrs);
};

export const STORAGE_KEY = 'markdown-notes/content';

export const saveNote = (storage, content) => {
  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify({ v: 1, content: content ?? '' }));
};

export const loadNote = (storage) => {
  const raw = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  if (!raw) return '';
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed.content === 'string') return parsed.content;
    return '';
  } catch {
    return '';
  }
};

export const clearNote = (storage) => {
  storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
};

# Markdown notes SPA — sprint 1 summary

## Stack decision + rationale (trade-offs)

**Chosen stack:** vanilla HTML + CSS + native ES modules (no framework) served as static files via `http-server`.

**Rationale:** this is a single-screen split-pane editor with one shared state value (the note text) and no routing. A component framework + build pipeline would add build/verify cost without materially simplifying the logic.

**Trade-offs:**
- Pro: minimal moving parts, fast startup, easy-to-test pure modules via `node --test`.
- Con: no full CommonMark support; the renderer is intentionally small and purpose-built for this surface.

## What was built

- Single-page split view: left pane is a `<textarea>` markdown editor; right pane is a live preview.
- Live preview updates on every editor `input`.
- Autosave to `localStorage` (debounced) and restore on page load.
- Keyboard shortcuts:
  - `Ctrl+S` triggers a save and shows a “Saved” status message.
  - `Ctrl+L` clears the note (and storage) and shows “Cleared”.
- Markdown rendering + sanitization:
  - `markdownToHtml()` converts a small markdown subset to HTML.
  - User content is HTML-escaped (safe-by-construction), then the resulting HTML is run through `sanitizeHtml()` (allowlist tags/attrs) as defense-in-depth.

## Accessibility decisions

- Semantic controls: real `<button>` elements for actions and a real `<textarea>` for editing.
- Accessible names: the editor is labeled (“Markdown editor”). The preview is exposed as a `role="region"` with aria-label (“Live preview”).
- Shortcut discoverability: the editor references the shortcut hint via `aria-describedby="shortcuts"`.
- Status updates: save/clear feedback is via a `role="status"` live region.
- Keyboard operability: shortcuts work from anywhere; focus ring is visible via `:focus-visible`.
- Contrast: light text on dark background with clear focus outline.

## Tests and coverage

### Unit tests (pure logic)
- `src/storage.js`: save/load/clear against an injected storage interface (covers invalid JSON and missing data).
- `src/markdown.js`:
  - `markdownToHtml()` renders headings/paragraphs and escapes raw HTML.
  - `sanitizeHtml()` removes unsafe link protocols (`javascript:`) and strips disallowed attributes while forcing safe `rel`/`target`.

**Result:** `npm test` PASS (9/9).

### E2E tests (Playwright)
- Typing in editor updates preview and content is restored after reload (localStorage persistence).
- Keyboard shortcuts: `Ctrl+S` shows Saved; `Ctrl+L` clears.
- Sanitization: attempts to inject `<script>` / `<img onerror>` are not rendered as executable markup in the preview.

**Result:** `npx playwright test` PASS (3/3).

## Notes / known gaps

- The markdown renderer supports a limited subset (headings, paragraphs, blockquotes, lists, fenced code, inline code, bold/italics, http(s) links). It is not a full CommonMark implementation.

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { markdownToHtml } from '../src/markdown.js';

test('markdownToHtml renders headings and paragraphs', () => {
  const html = markdownToHtml('# Title\n\nHello world');
  assert.match(html, /<h1>Title<\/h1>/);
  assert.match(html, /<p>Hello world<\/p>/);
});

test('markdownToHtml escapes raw HTML so script tags do not survive', () => {
  const html = markdownToHtml('Hi <script>alert(1)</script>');
  assert.ok(!html.includes('<script>'));
  assert.match(html, /&lt;script&gt;alert\(1\)&lt;\/script&gt;/);
});

test('markdownToHtml renders fenced code blocks without interpreting markup', () => {
  const html = markdownToHtml('```\n<em>nope</em>\n```');
  assert.match(html, /<pre><code>/);
  assert.match(html, /&lt;em&gt;nope&lt;\/em&gt;/);
});

// Not used by the app; used only by unit tests that need a minimal DOM.
export class FakeElement {
  constructor(tagName) {
    this.tagName = tagName.toUpperCase();
    this._attrs = new Map();
    this.children = [];
    this.textContent = '';
    this._replacedWith = null;
  }
  get attributes() {
    return Array.from(this._attrs.entries()).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));
  }
  setAttribute(name, value) {
    this._attrs.set(name, String(value));
  }
  getAttribute(name) {
    return this._attrs.has(name) ? this._attrs.get(name) : null;
  }
  removeAttribute(name) {
    this._attrs.delete(name);
  }
  replaceWith(node) {
    this._replacedWith = node;
  }
}

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { FakeElement } from './sanitize-dom-shim.js';

const parseAnchorOnly = (doc, html) => {
  const m = html.match(/<a\s+([^>]+)>([\s\S]*)<\/a>/i);
  if (!m) return;
  const attrStr = m[1];
  const inner = m[2];
  const el = new FakeElement('a');
  el.textContent = inner.replaceAll(/<[^>]*>/g, '');

  for (const piece of attrStr.split(/\s+/)) {
    const am = piece.match(/^([^=]+)=("[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s]+)$/);
    if (!am) continue;
    const name = am[1];
    let value = am[2];
    if ((value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')) || (value.startsWith("'") && value.endsWith("'"))) {
      value = value.slice(1, -1);
    }
    el.setAttribute(name, value);
  }

  doc.body.children = [el];
};

// Stub DOMParser used by src/markdown.js
globalThis.DOMParser = class {
  parseFromString(html) {
    const doc = {
      body: new FakeElement('body'),
      createTextNode: (text) => ({ nodeType: 3, textContent: String(text) }),
    };
    parseAnchorOnly(doc, html);
    return doc;
  }
};

import { sanitizeHtml } from '../src/markdown.js';

test('sanitizeHtml removes javascript: href and strips disallowed attrs', () => {
  const out = sanitizeHtml('<a href="javascript:alert(1)" onclick="alert(1)">x</a>');
  assert.ok(out.includes('<a'));
  assert.ok(!out.includes('onclick='));
  assert.ok(!out.includes('href="javascript:'));
});

test('sanitizeHtml keeps https href and forces rel/target', () => {
  const out = sanitizeHtml('<a href="https://example.com">x</a>');
  assert.match(out, /href="https:\/\/example\.com"/);
  assert.match(out, /rel="noopener noreferrer"/);
  assert.match(out, /target="_blank"/);
});

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { STORAGE_KEY, clearNote, loadNote, saveNote } from '../src/storage.js';

const makeStorage = () => {
  const map = new Map();
  return {
    getItem: (k) => (map.has(k) ? map.get(k) : null),
    setItem: (k, v) => map.set(k, String(v)),
    removeItem: (k) => map.delete(k),
    _map: map,
  };
};

test('saveNote writes versioned JSON at the storage key', () => {
  const storage = makeStorage();
  saveNote(storage, 'hello');

  const raw = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  assert.ok(raw);
  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  assert.deepEqual(parsed, { v: 1, content: 'hello' });
});

test('loadNote returns empty string when nothing is stored', () => {
  const storage = makeStorage();
  assert.equal(loadNote(storage), '');
});

test('loadNote tolerates invalid JSON and returns empty string', () => {
  const storage = makeStorage();
  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, '{not json');
  assert.equal(loadNote(storage), '');
});

test('clearNote removes the storage item', () => {
  const storage = makeStorage();
  saveNote(storage, 'x');
  clearNote(storage);
  assert.equal(storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY), null);
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('persists settings + timer state to localStorage and restores after reload', async ({ page }) => {
  // Drive time deterministically.
  await page.clock.install({ time: Date.now() });

  await page.goto('/');

  const workInput = page.getByLabel('Work');
  const breakInput = page.getByLabel('Break');

  await workInput.fill('2');
  await breakInput.fill('3');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }).click();

  await expect(page.locator('#timeLeft')).toHaveText('02:00');

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start' }).click();
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:00:20');

  // Reload should restore settings and a running timer computed from timestamps.
  await page.reload();

  await expect(workInput).toHaveValue('2');
  await expect(breakInput).toHaveValue('3');
  await expect(page.locator('#status')).toContainText('Running');

  const afterReload = await page.locator('#timeLeft').textContent();
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:00:10');
  await expect(page.locator('#timeLeft')).not.toHaveText(afterReload ?? '');

  // Pause state should also persist.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pause' }).click();
  const paused = await page.locator('#timeLeft').textContent();

  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.locator('#status')).toContainText('Paused');
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:00:10');
  await expect(page.locator('#timeLeft')).toHaveText(paused ?? '');
});

test('persists history across reload after an interval completes', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.clock.install({ time: Date.now() });
  await page.goto('/');

  await page.getByLabel('Work').fill('1');
  await page.getByLabel('Break').fill('1');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }).click();

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start' }).click();
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:01:05');

  const historyItems = page.locator('#history > li');
  await expect(historyItems).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(historyItems.first()).toContainText('Work');

  await page.reload();

  const afterReload = page.locator('#history > li');
  await expect(afterReload).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(afterReload.first()).toContainText('Work');
});

test('shows in-app interval-complete notice when OS notifications are unavailable', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    // Simulate no Notifications API.
    // @ts-ignore
    delete window.Notification;
  });

  await page.clock.install({ time: Date.now() });
  await page.goto('/');

  await page.getByLabel('Work').fill('1');
  await page.getByLabel('Break').fill('1');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }).click();

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start' }).click();
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:01:05');

  const notice = page.locator('#notice');
  await expect(notice).toBeVisible();
  await expect(notice).toContainText('Work complete');
});

test('reload catch-up handles an overdue timer (at least one completion)', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.clock.install({ time: Date.now() });
  await page.goto('/');

  await page.getByLabel('Work').fill('1');
  await page.getByLabel('Break').fill('1');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }).click();

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start' }).click();

  // Jump the clock beyond the current work interval *without* letting UI ticks run.
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:01:10');
  await page.reload();

  const historyItems = page.locator('#history > li');
  await expect(historyItems).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(historyItems.first()).toContainText('Work');
  await expect(page.locator('#modeLabel')).toHaveText('Break');
});

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('configure durations, start/pause/reset, auto-switch, and history update', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.clock.install({ time: Date.now() });
  await page.goto('/');

  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pomodoro' })).toBeVisible();

  const workInput = page.getByLabel('Work');
  const breakInput = page.getByLabel('Break');
  await workInput.fill('1');
  await breakInput.fill('1');
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Apply' }).click();

  const timeLeft = page.locator('#timeLeft');
  await expect(timeLeft).toHaveText('01:00');

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start' }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('#status')).toContainText('Running');

  // Pause should freeze the remaining time.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pause' }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('#status')).toContainText('Paused');
  const pausedText = await timeLeft.textContent();
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:00:05');
  await expect(timeLeft).toHaveText(pausedText ?? '');

  // Resume and complete the work interval.
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Start' }).click();
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:01:01');

  await expect(page.locator('#modeLabel')).toHaveText('Break');

  const historyItems = page.locator('#history > li');
  await expect(historyItems).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(historyItems.first()).toContainText('Work');

  // Complete the break interval and ensure we switch back.
  await page.clock.fastForward('00:01:01');
  await expect(page.locator('#modeLabel')).toHaveText('Work');
  await expect(historyItems).toHaveCount(2);
  await expect(historyItems.first()).toContainText('Break');

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset' }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('#timeLeft')).toHaveText('01:00');
});

import { initialState, reduce, formatMs, minutesToMs, MODES, sanitizeSettings } from './timer-core.js';
import { loadState, saveState } from './storage.js';

const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

const startBtn = /** @type {HTMLButtonElement|null} */ ($('startBtn'));
const pauseBtn = /** @type {HTMLButtonElement|null} */ ($('pauseBtn'));
const resetBtn = /** @type {HTMLButtonElement|null} */ ($('resetBtn'));
const statusEl = $('status');

const modeLabel = $('modeLabel');
const timeLeftEl = $('timeLeft');
const noticeEl = $('notice');

const settingsForm = /** @type {HTMLFormElement|null} */ ($('settingsForm'));
const workMinutesInput = /** @type {HTMLInputElement|null} */ ($('workMinutes'));
const breakMinutesInput = /** @type {HTMLInputElement|null} */ ($('breakMinutes'));

const historyEl = /** @type {HTMLOListElement|null} */ ($('history'));

const showFatalError = (message) => {
  const container = document.querySelector('main') ?? document.body;
  const el = document.createElement('p');
  el.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
  el.style.padding = '1rem';
  el.textContent = message;
  container.prepend(el);
};

const hasRequiredEls =
  startBtn instanceof HTMLButtonElement &&
  pauseBtn instanceof HTMLButtonElement &&
  resetBtn instanceof HTMLButtonElement &&
  settingsForm instanceof HTMLFormElement &&
  workMinutesInput instanceof HTMLInputElement &&
  breakMinutesInput instanceof HTMLInputElement &&
  historyEl instanceof HTMLOListElement &&
  modeLabel instanceof HTMLElement &&
  timeLeftEl instanceof HTMLElement &&
  noticeEl instanceof HTMLElement;

if (!hasRequiredEls) {
  showFatalError('App failed to load: missing required UI elements.');
} else {
  const requestNotificationPermissionIfNeeded = async () => {
    if (!('Notification' in window)) return;
    if (Notification.permission === 'default') {
      try {
        await Notification.requestPermission();
      } catch {
        // Ignore.
      }
    }
  };

  /** @type {ReturnType<typeof initialState>} */
  let state;

  const catchUpRunningState = (runningState, now) => {
    // If the app has been backgrounded/offline, multiple intervals may have completed.
    // Advance through them based on timestamps (endAt), but do it efficiently by skipping whole pairs.
    let next = runningState;

    if (!next.isRunning || typeof next.endAt !== 'number') return next;

    const workMs = minutesToMs(next.settings.workMinutes);
    const breakMs = minutesToMs(next.settings.breakMinutes);

    // Fast-forward through full cycles without emitting per-interval history.
    // This keeps the loop bounded even if the user was away for hours.
    const cycleMs = workMs + breakMs;

    if (cycleMs > 0 && now - next.endAt > cycleMs) {
      const elapsedSinceFirstCompletion = now - next.endAt;
      const fullCycles = Math.floor(elapsedSinceFirstCompletion / cycleMs);
      if (fullCycles > 0) {
        next = { ...next, endAt: next.endAt + fullCycles * cycleMs };
      }
    }

    let safety = 0;
    while (next.isRunning && typeof next.endAt === 'number' && next.endAt <= now && safety < 10) {
      const completionTime = next.endAt;
      next = reduce(next, {
        type: 'tick',
        now: completionTime,
        id: `${completionTime}-${safety}-${next.mode}`,
      });
      safety++;
    }

    if (next.isRunning && typeof next.endAt === 'number') {
      next.remainingMs = Math.max(0, next.endAt - now);
    }

    return next;
  };

  const restore = () => {
    const persisted = loadState(window.localStorage);
    const base = initialState(persisted ?? undefined);

    const now = Date.now();

    if (base.isRunning) {
      if (typeof base.endAt !== 'number') {
        // Malformed running state: pause it.
        base.isRunning = false;
        base.endAt = null;
      } else {
        state = catchUpRunningState(base, now);
        return;
      }
    }

    // If we reach here, we are not running.
    // Trust persisted remainingMs (paused timer) if it's valid; otherwise derive from (mode, settings).
    if (!Number.isFinite(base.remainingMs) || base.remainingMs < 0) {
      base.remainingMs =
        base.mode === MODES.break
          ? minutesToMs(base.settings.breakMinutes)
          : minutesToMs(base.settings.workMinutes);
    }

    state = base;
  };

  const persist = () => {
    const { notice: _notice, ...persistable } = state;
    saveState(window.localStorage, persistable);
  };

  const renderHistory = () => {
    historyEl.innerHTML = '';
    for (const entry of state.history) {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      const when = new Date(entry.completedAt);
      const label = entry.mode === MODES.work ? 'Work' : 'Break';
      li.textContent = `${label} • ${when.toLocaleTimeString([], {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      })}`;
      historyEl.append(li);
    }
  };

  const setNotice = (text) => {
    if (!text) {
      noticeEl.hidden = true;
      noticeEl.textContent = '';
      return;
    }
    noticeEl.hidden = false;
    noticeEl.textContent = text;
  };

  const render = () => {
    modeLabel.textContent = state.mode === MODES.work ? 'Work' : 'Break';
    timeLeftEl.textContent = formatMs(state.remainingMs);

    workMinutesInput.value = String(state.settings.workMinutes);
    breakMinutesInput.value = String(state.settings.breakMinutes);

    startBtn.disabled = state.isRunning;
    pauseBtn.disabled = !state.isRunning;

    statusEl.textContent = state.isRunning ? 'Running' : 'Paused';

    renderHistory();
    setNotice(state.notice);
  };

  let tickTimer = 0;
  const stopTicking = () => {
    if (tickTimer) window.clearInterval(tickTimer);
    tickTimer = 0;
  };

  const dispatch = (action) => {
    state = reduce(state, action);
    render();
    persist();

    if (state.notice) {
      // Gentle in-app notice is already shown; try OS notification if permitted.
      if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
        try {
          new Notification('Pomodoro', { body: state.notice });
        } catch {
          // ignore
        }
      }

      // Auto-clear notice after a moment.
      window.clearTimeout(dispatch._noticeTimer);
      dispatch._noticeTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        state = reduce(state, { type: 'clearNotice' });
        render();
        persist();
      }, 4000);
    }

    if (state.isRunning && !tickTimer) {
      tickTimer = window.setInterval(() => dispatch({ type: 'tick', now: Date.now() }), 250);
    }
    if (!state.isRunning) stopTicking();
  };
  dispatch._noticeTimer = 0;

  const applySettingsFromForm = () => {
    const settings = sanitizeSettings({
      workMinutes: Number(workMinutesInput.value),
      breakMinutes: Number(breakMinutesInput.value),
    });
    dispatch({ type: 'applySettings', settings });
    statusEl.textContent = state.isRunning ? 'Running' : 'Paused';
  };

  startBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    await requestNotificationPermissionIfNeeded();
    dispatch({ type: 'start', now: Date.now() });
  });
  pauseBtn.addEventListener('click', () => dispatch({ type: 'pause', now: Date.now() }));
  resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => dispatch({ type: 'reset' }));

  settingsForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    applySettingsFromForm();
  });

  window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key !== ' ') return;
    const target = /** @type {HTMLElement|null} */ (e.target instanceof HTMLElement ? e.target : null);
    // Avoid stealing space from form inputs.
    if (target && (target.tagName === 'INPUT' || target.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || target.isContentEditable)) {
      return;
    }
    e.preventDefault();
    if (state.isRunning) dispatch({ type: 'pause', now: Date.now() });
    else dispatch({ type: 'start', now: Date.now() });
  });

  // Boot
  restore();
  render();
  persist();

  if (state.isRunning) {
    tickTimer = window.setInterval(() => dispatch({ type: 'tick', now: Date.now() }), 250);
  }
}

const escapeHtml = (s) =>
  s
    .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
    .replaceAll('<', '&lt;')
    .replaceAll('>', '&gt;')
    .replaceAll('"', '&quot;')
    .replaceAll("'", '&#39;');

const inlineMarkdownToHtml = (text) => {
  // Escape first, then re-introduce safe HTML for markdown constructs.
  let html = escapeHtml(text);

  // Code spans
  html = html.replaceAll(/`([^`]+)`/g, '<code>$1</code>');

  // Links: [text](https://...)
  html = html.replaceAll(
    /\[([^\]]+)\]\((https?:\/\/[^\s)]+)\)/g,
    '<a href="$2" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">$1</a>'
  );

  // Bold + italics
  html = html.replaceAll(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, '<strong>$1</strong>');
  html = html.replaceAll(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, '<em>$1</em>');

  return html;
};

const serializeAttributes = (el, allowedForTag) => {
  const parts = [];
  for (const attr of Array.from(el.attributes ?? [])) {
    if (!allowedForTag?.has(attr.name)) continue;
    const value = String(attr.value ?? '');
    const escaped = value
      .replaceAll('&', '&amp;')
      .replaceAll('"', '&quot;');
    parts.push(`${attr.name}="${escaped}"`);
  }
  return parts.length ? ' ' + parts.join(' ') : '';
};

const serializeNode = (node, allowedAttrs) => {
  const pieces = [];
  for (const child of Array.from(node.children ?? [])) {
    const attrs = serializeAttributes(child, allowedAttrs[child.tagName]);
    const inner = child.children?.length
      ? serializeNode(child, allowedAttrs)
      : escapeHtml(child.textContent ?? '');
    pieces.push(`<${child.tagName.toLowerCase()}${attrs}>${inner}</${child.tagName.toLowerCase()}>`);
  }
  return pieces.join('');
};

/**
 * A tiny markdown-to-HTML renderer for the preview.
 * Supported: headings (#, ##, ###), paragraphs, blockquotes, unordered lists,
 * fenced code blocks, inline code, bold/italics, and http(s) links.
 *
 * Output is safe-by-construction (escapes user content), but still run through
 * `sanitizeHtml` as a defense-in-depth step.
 */
export const markdownToHtml = (markdown) => {
  const input = (markdown ?? '').replaceAll('\r\n', '\n');
  const lines = input.split('\n');

  const out = [];
  let inCode = false;
  let codeLines = [];
  let inList = false;

  const closeList = () => {
    if (inList) {
      out.push('</ul>');
      inList = false;
    }
  };

  for (const line of lines) {
    const trimmed = line.trimEnd();

    if (trimmed.startsWith('```')) {
      if (inCode) {
        out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n'))}</code></pre>`);
        inCode = false;
        codeLines = [];
      } else {
        closeList();
        inCode = true;
      }
      continue;
    }

    if (inCode) {
      codeLines.push(line);
      continue;
    }

    if (trimmed === '') {
      closeList();
      continue;
    }

    const h3 = trimmed.match(/^###\s+(.+)$/);
    if (h3) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<h3>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(h3[1])}</h3>`);
      continue;
    }

    const h2 = trimmed.match(/^##\s+(.+)$/);
    if (h2) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<h2>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(h2[1])}</h2>`);
      continue;
    }

    const h1 = trimmed.match(/^#\s+(.+)$/);
    if (h1) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<h1>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(h1[1])}</h1>`);
      continue;
    }

    const bq = trimmed.match(/^>\s?(.+)$/);
    if (bq) {
      closeList();
      out.push(`<blockquote><p>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(bq[1])}</p></blockquote>`);
      continue;
    }

    const li = trimmed.match(/^-\s+(.+)$/);
    if (li) {
      if (!inList) {
        out.push('<ul>');
        inList = true;
      }
      out.push(`<li>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(li[1])}</li>`);
      continue;
    }

    closeList();
    out.push(`<p>${inlineMarkdownToHtml(trimmed)}</p>`);
  }

  closeList();
  if (inCode) {
    out.push(`<pre><code>${escapeHtml(codeLines.join('\n'))}</code></pre>`);
  }

  return out.join('\n');
};

/**
 * Sanitizes HTML by parsing it and removing dangerous elements/attributes.
 * Keep an allowlist small: the preview only needs basic formatting.
 */
export const sanitizeHtml = (html) => {
  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(html ?? '', 'text/html');

  const allowedTags = new Set([
    'A',
    'P',
    'H1',
    'H2',
    'H3',
    'EM',
    'STRONG',
    'CODE',
    'PRE',
    'UL',
    'OL',
    'LI',
    'BLOCKQUOTE',
    'BR',
  ]);

  const allowedAttrs = {
    A: new Set(['href', 'rel', 'target']),
  };

  const walk = (node) => {
    const children = Array.from(node.children ?? []);
    for (const el of children) {
      if (!allowedTags.has(el.tagName)) {
        const text = doc.createTextNode(el.textContent ?? '');
        el.replaceWith(text);
        continue;
      }

      for (const attr of Array.from(el.attributes ?? [])) {
        const allowedForTag = allowedAttrs[el.tagName];
        const isAllowed = allowedForTag?.has(attr.name);
        if (!isAllowed) el.removeAttribute(attr.name);
      }

      if (el.tagName === 'A') {
        const href = el.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (!/^https?:\/\//i.test(href)) el.removeAttribute('href');
        el.setAttribute('rel', 'noopener noreferrer');
        el.setAttribute('target', '_blank');
      }

      walk(el);
    }
  };

  walk(doc.body);

  // Use a deterministic serializer (so unit tests can stub DOMParser in Node).
  if (typeof doc.body.innerHTML === 'string') return doc.body.innerHTML;
  return serializeNode(doc.body, allowedAttrs);
};
src/storage.js24 lines 
export const STORAGE_KEY = 'pomodoro/state';

export const saveState = (storage, state) => {
  storage.setItem(
    STORAGE_KEY,
    JSON.stringify({ v: 1, state: state ?? null })
  );
};

export const loadState = (storage) => {
  const raw = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (parsed && parsed.v === 1) return parsed.state ?? null;
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

export const clearState = (storage) => {
  storage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
};

:root{

}
*{box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{height:100%;}
body{margin:0;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);}

.topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:0.75rem 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--panel);}
.topbar__title{font-size:1rem;margin:0;letter-spacing:0.02em;}
.topbar__actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}

button{background:var(--btn);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.45rem 0.7rem;border-radius:0.6rem;cursor:pointer;}
button:hover{background:var(--btn-hover);}
button[disabled]{opacity:0.55;cursor:not-allowed;}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px;}

input{background:transparent;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:0.4rem 0.5rem;border-radius:0.5rem;}

.status{min-width:10ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:0.9rem;}

.layout{height:calc(100% - 54px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:0;}
.pane{min-height:0;border-right:1px solid var(--border);padding:1rem;}
.pane:last-child{border-right:none;}

.timer{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5rem;align-items:flex-start;}
.timer__mode{margin:0;color:var(--muted);}
.timer__time{margin:0;font-size:3rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:0.03em;}

.notice{margin-top:1rem;padding:0.75rem 0.8rem;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:0.75rem;background:var(--notice);color:var(--text);}

.form{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.75rem;}
.field{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;}
.field label{color:var(--text);}

.history{margin:0;padding-left:1.25rem;color:var(--muted);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.35rem;}

.hint{margin:0.5rem 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:0.85rem;}

.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0;}

@media (max-width: 900px){
  .layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto auto auto;height:auto;}
  .pane{border-right:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  .pane:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
}

export const MODES = /** @type {const} */ ({
  work: 'work',
  break: 'break',
});

export const DEFAULT_SETTINGS = {
  workMinutes: 25,
  breakMinutes: 5,
};

const clampInt = (value, min, max) => {
  const n = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(n)) return min;
  const i = Math.round(n);
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, i));
};

export const sanitizeSettings = (settings) => {
  const s = settings ?? {};
  return {
    workMinutes: clampInt(s.workMinutes, 1, 120),
    breakMinutes: clampInt(s.breakMinutes, 1, 60),
  };
};

export const minutesToMs = (minutes) => Math.round(minutes * 60_000);

export const formatMs = (ms) => {
  const totalSeconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(ms / 1000));
  const m = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60);
  const s = totalSeconds % 60;
  return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

const durationForModeMs = (mode, settings) =>
  mode === MODES.break ? minutesToMs(settings.breakMinutes) : minutesToMs(settings.workMinutes);

export const initialState = ({
  settings = DEFAULT_SETTINGS,
  mode = MODES.work,
  isRunning = false,
  endAt = null,
  remainingMs,
  history = [],
} = {}) => {
  const safeSettings = sanitizeSettings(settings);
  const safeMode = mode === MODES.break ? MODES.break : MODES.work;

  // When paused, we want to preserve remainingMs so pause/resume works across reload.
  // But we must reject obviously invalid values.
  const baseRemainingMs = durationForModeMs(safeMode, safeSettings);
  const pausedRemainingMs =
    typeof remainingMs === 'number' && Number.isFinite(remainingMs) && remainingMs >= 0
      ? remainingMs
      : baseRemainingMs;

  return {
    settings: safeSettings,
    mode: safeMode,
    isRunning: Boolean(isRunning),
    endAt: typeof endAt === 'number' ? endAt : null,
    remainingMs: Boolean(isRunning) ? baseRemainingMs : pausedRemainingMs,
    history: Array.isArray(history) ? history : [],
    notice: null,
  };
};

export const reduce = (state, action) => {
  const s = state;
  switch (action.type) {
    case 'applySettings': {
      const settings = sanitizeSettings(action.settings);
      const modeMs = durationForModeMs(s.mode, settings);
      return {
        ...s,
        settings,
        remainingMs: s.isRunning ? s.remainingMs : modeMs,
        notice: null,
      };
    }
    case 'start': {
      if (s.isRunning) return s;
      const now = action.now;
      return {
        ...s,
        isRunning: true,
        endAt: now + s.remainingMs,
        notice: null,
      };
    }
    case 'pause': {
      if (!s.isRunning) return s;
      const now = action.now;
      const remainingMs = Math.max(0, s.endAt - now);
      return {
        ...s,
        isRunning: false,
        endAt: null,
        remainingMs,
        notice: null,
      };
    }
    case 'reset': {
      const modeMs = durationForModeMs(s.mode, s.settings);
      return {
        ...s,
        isRunning: false,
        endAt: null,
        remainingMs: modeMs,
        notice: null,
      };
    }
    case 'tick': {
      if (!s.isRunning) return s;
      const now = action.now;
      if (typeof s.endAt !== 'number') {
        return { ...s, isRunning: false, endAt: null, notice: null };
      }
      const remainingMs = Math.max(0, s.endAt - now);
      if (remainingMs > 0) return { ...s, remainingMs, notice: null };

      const completedMode = s.mode;
      const nextMode = completedMode === MODES.work ? MODES.break : MODES.work;

      const nextDurationMs = durationForModeMs(nextMode, s.settings);

      const entry = {
        id: action.id ?? `${now}-${completedMode}`,
        mode: completedMode,
        completedAt: now,
        durationMs: durationForModeMs(completedMode, s.settings),
      };

      return {
        ...s,
        mode: nextMode,
        isRunning: true,
        endAt: now + nextDurationMs,
        remainingMs: nextDurationMs,
        history: [entry, ...s.history].slice(0, 50),
        notice: completedMode === MODES.work ? 'Work complete. Break time.' : 'Break complete. Back to work.',
      };
    }
    case 'clearNotice': {
      return { ...s, notice: null };
    }
    default:
      return s;
  }
};

# Pomodoro – sprint 1 summary

## Stack decision + rationale

**Chosen stack/framework:** Vanilla HTML + CSS + ES modules (no framework), served with `http-server`.

**Rationale / trade-offs:** This deliverable is a single-page UI with modest shared state (timer engine + settings + session history). A framework would add build and dependency weight without adding much value for one screen. Keeping the core timer logic as a pure reducer (`src/timer-core.js`) makes unit tests straightforward with Node’s built-in test runner (`node --test`). Trade-off: we hand-wire DOM rendering/events in `src/app.js`, but the surface area stays small and verifiable.

## What shipped

- **Timer engine (pure reducer):** `src/timer-core.js`
  - Supports **start**, **pause**, **resume** (start after pause), and **reset**.
  - Uses `endAt` timestamps so remaining time is computed as `endAt - now` (drift-resistant).
  - On interval completion (`tick` at/after `endAt`), **auto-switches** Work ↔ Break, continues running, and adds a history entry.

- **Persistence:** `src/storage.js` + wiring in `src/app.js`
  - Persists settings, timer state, and session history to `localStorage`.
  - Restores on app start.
  - If timer was running on close, restore recomputes remaining time from persisted `endAt` and performs an overdue catch-up tick if the interval completed while away.

- **Notification trigger + fallback:** `src/app.js`
  - Always shows a gentle in-app notice (`#notice`, `role="status"`, `aria-live="polite"`) when an interval completes.
  - Also triggers an OS notification via the Notifications API when available and permission is granted.

- **UI:** `index.html` + `src/app.js`
  - Configurable **work** and **break** durations (minutes).
  - Displays current mode (Work/Break) and time remaining.
  - Controls: Start, Pause, Reset.
  - History view rendered from persisted state.

## Tests

### Unit tests
Command: `npm test`

What they cover:
- Engine transitions: start → tick (remaining), pause (freezes time), reset.
- Interval completion switching logic and history entry recording.
- Paused-state persistence semantics in `initialState`.
- Storage round-trip and invalid data handling.

Result: **PASS** (captured in `test_evidence/unit.txt`).

### E2E tests (Playwright)
Command: `npx playwright test` (also `npm run e2e`)

What they cover:
- Configure durations → start/pause/resume/reset.
- Run through interval completion(s) and verify mode switching and history recording.
- Persistence across reload: settings + running/paused timer restore.
- History persists across reload.
- Notification fallback: when `window.Notification` is unavailable, the in-app notice appears on interval completion.

Result: **PASS** (captured in `test_evidence/e2e.txt`).

## Accessibility notes

- Semantic form controls with labels (`<label for>`), and buttons have visible text.
- `#status` and `#notice` use live regions so state/interval completion is announced.
- Keyboard: Space toggles start/pause when focus is not inside a text input.
- Visible focus ring preserved (no outline removal).

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { sanitizeSettings } from '../src/timer-core.js';

test('sanitizeSettings clamps to allowed ranges and rounds', () => {
  assert.deepEqual(sanitizeSettings({ workMinutes: 0, breakMinutes: 0 }), { workMinutes: 1, breakMinutes: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(sanitizeSettings({ workMinutes: 121, breakMinutes: 999 }), { workMinutes: 120, breakMinutes: 60 });
  assert.deepEqual(sanitizeSettings({ workMinutes: 10.2, breakMinutes: 5.7 }), { workMinutes: 10, breakMinutes: 6 });
});

// Not used by the app; used only by unit tests that need a minimal DOM.
export class FakeElement {
  constructor(tagName) {
    this.tagName = tagName.toUpperCase();
    this._attrs = new Map();
    this.children = [];
    this.textContent = '';
    this._replacedWith = null;
  }
  get attributes() {
    return Array.from(this._attrs.entries()).map(([name, value]) => ({ name, value }));
  }
  setAttribute(name, value) {
    this._attrs.set(name, String(value));
  }
  getAttribute(name) {
    return this._attrs.has(name) ? this._attrs.get(name) : null;
  }
  removeAttribute(name) {
    this._attrs.delete(name);
  }
  replaceWith(node) {
    this._replacedWith = node;
  }
}

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { initialState, reduce, minutesToMs, MODES } from '../src/timer-core.js';

test('history is capped to 50 entries (most recent first)', () => {
  let s = initialState({ settings: { workMinutes: 1, breakMinutes: 1 } });
  s = reduce(s, { type: 'start', now: 0 });

  for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
    // Force completion immediately by setting endAt in the past.
    s.endAt = 0;
    s.isRunning = true;
    s = reduce(s, { type: 'tick', now: i + 1, id: String(i) });
  }

  assert.equal(s.history.length, 50);
  assert.equal(s.history[0].id, '54');
});

test('reset sets remaining time to current mode duration', () => {
  const s0 = initialState({ settings: { workMinutes: 2, breakMinutes: 3 }, mode: MODES.break });
  const s1 = reduce(s0, { type: 'reset' });
  assert.equal(s1.remainingMs, minutesToMs(3));
});

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { loadState, saveState, STORAGE_KEY } from '../src/storage.js';

class MemoryStorage {
  /** @type {Map<string,string>} */
  #map = new Map();
  getItem(k) {
    return this.#map.has(k) ? this.#map.get(k) : null;
  }
  setItem(k, v) {
    this.#map.set(k, String(v));
  }
  removeItem(k) {
    this.#map.delete(k);
  }
}

test('storage saves and loads pomodoro state round-trip', () => {
  const storage = new MemoryStorage();
  const state = { settings: { workMinutes: 10, breakMinutes: 2 }, mode: 'work' };
  saveState(storage, state);
  assert.ok(storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY));
  assert.deepEqual(loadState(storage), state);
});

test('storage returns null for missing or invalid data', () => {
  const storage = new MemoryStorage();
  assert.equal(loadState(storage), null);
  storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, 'not json');
  assert.equal(loadState(storage), null);
});

import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { initialState, reduce, MODES, minutesToMs } from '../src/timer-core.js';

test('start sets endAt based on wall clock time (drift-correct baseline)', () => {
  const s0 = initialState({ settings: { workMinutes: 1, breakMinutes: 1 } });
  const now = 1_000_000;
  const s1 = reduce(s0, { type: 'start', now });
  assert.equal(s1.isRunning, true);
  assert.equal(s1.endAt, now + s0.remainingMs);
});

test('tick computes remainingMs based on endAt - now (no interval drift accumulation)', () => {
  const now = 10_000;
  const s0 = initialState({ settings: { workMinutes: 1, breakMinutes: 1 } });
  const s1 = reduce(s0, { type: 'start', now });
  const s2 = reduce(s1, { type: 'tick', now: now + 12_345 });
  assert.equal(s2.remainingMs, Math.max(0, s1.endAt - (now + 12_345)));
});

test('pause freezes remaining time and clears endAt', () => {
  const s0 = initialState({ settings: { workMinutes: 1, breakMinutes: 1 } });
  const s1 = reduce(s0, { type: 'start', now: 1000 });
  const s2 = reduce(s1, { type: 'pause', now: 2000 });
  assert.equal(s2.isRunning, false);
  assert.equal(s2.endAt, null);
  assert.equal(s2.remainingMs, Math.max(0, s1.endAt - 2000));
});

test('auto-switches modes and records history when interval completes', () => {
  const s0 = initialState({ settings: { workMinutes: 1, breakMinutes: 2 } });
  const startAt = 1000;
  const s1 = reduce(s0, { type: 'start', now: startAt });

  // Tick after the interval would have ended.
  const endNow = s1.endAt + 1;
  const s2 = reduce(s1, { type: 'tick', now: endNow, id: 'x' });

  assert.equal(s2.mode, MODES.break);
  assert.equal(s2.isRunning, true);
  assert.equal(s2.remainingMs, minutesToMs(2));
  assert.equal(s2.history.length, 1);
  assert.equal(s2.history[0].mode, MODES.work);
});

test('initialState preserves paused remainingMs across reload', () => {
  const s = initialState({
    settings: { workMinutes: 2, breakMinutes: 3 },
    mode: MODES.work,
    isRunning: false,
    remainingMs: minutesToMs(1.5),
  });
  assert.equal(s.remainingMs, minutesToMs(1.5));
});
